author: Tarheelkiwi
body:
Hey players of Avicus,

This is my favorite server to play on.  The intense pvp battles make playtime exciting.  The server isn't dying, however, it can improve.  There are a few games I would love to see in the next update, Hunger Games, Hide-And-Seek, and Splegg.

Hunger Games:
Why should it be in Avicus?:

Arguably the most popular game on any server.  Hunger Games forces you to use your pvp skills along with cunning strategies.  Also, playing a Hunger Games could make relationships between players.  Teaming up with another player could create a friendship.

XP:

Non donors: 1xp per kill
                     10xp for 1st place
                      5xp for 2nd

Gold: 1.5xp per kill
          10xp for 1st
           5xp for 2nd

Emerald: 2xp per kill
               10xp for 1st
               5xp for 2nd

Diamond: 2.5xp per kill
                10xp for 1st
                5xp for 2nd

Hide-And-Seek:
Why should it be in Avicus?:

In Hide-And-Seek, players get to become their favorite blocks in Minecraft and hide from a seeker.  Players will have to use quick thinking to find a good hiding spot and stay away from the seeker.

Blocks:

Obviously there are a lot of blocks in Minecraft, so we should only use a few...

Non donors: Chest, Obsidian, Redstone Block, Redstone Ore, Soul Sand, Jack O Lantern, Note Block, Ice Block, Bookshelf, Melon Block, Pumpkin, Redstone Lamp Off, and Leavs

XP:

Non Donors: (If seeker) 2xp per kill
                     (If hider) 10xp per win

Gold: (If seeker) 2.5xp per kill
         (If hider) 10xp per win

Emerald: (If seeker) 4xp per kill
               (If hider) 10xp per win

Diamond: (If seeker) 5xp per kill
                (If hider) 10xp per win

Gold: Gold Block Ender Chest, Enchanting Table, Iron Block

Emerald: Emerald Block, Fence, Wall, Furnace,

Diamond: Diamond Block, Crafting Table, TNT, Beacon

Splegg:
Why should it be in Avicus?:

Lets get away from all that pvp and lets destroy a block from your opponents feet till they fall out of the world HAHAHA.  But for real, Splegg is a game where you shoot an egg from your spade spleef your opponents.

XP:

Non Donors: 1xp per kill
                     10xp for 1st
                      5xp for 2nd

Gold: 1.5xp per kill
          10xp for 1st
          5xp for 2nd

Emerald: 2xp per kill
               10xp for 1st
               5xp for 2nd

Diamond: 2.5xp per kill
                10xp for 1st
                5xp for 2nd

Please put this into consideration and think about it.  It isn't much.  It would be a great addition to the game selection.  I already did most of the thinking.  Thank you for sticking around to the end.  If you have other game ideas, reply.

-Tarheelkiwi

replies.author: o0vanessa0o
replies.body:
I believe we should work on the games we have before adding any more. I like the idea of hunger-games but that should be added after we work on other game modes.I don't have many ideas of ways to upgrade other game modes, but I know Elimination should be changed and upgraded.

              The reason why elimination and other game modes aren't as fun as before is because the player count has had a huge down drop since we changed from Mc Zone to Avicus. A way to have a greater player count is to add game modes. The game modes will attract players, and then the game play will be fun once again.

         Elimination; The compasses should be worked on. We should add some fun aspects to the game itself. The name should be changed to a better known name.  

                                      Ps. I'm sorry if I have any spelling mistakes, I'm tired today :P
